title: Spaces
about: Apps that run entirely in the visitor's browser, each sealed under one root digest.

inventory.note: a Space is listed by the catalog below; `served_here` counts the ones also published to /v2/ as OCI artifacts. A listed Space that is not published answers 404 there, and that is not an error.

catalog_note: the catalog is not published as an object yet, so this section has no address you can verify: read the static file named in `list`, and treat it as unaddressed

list.returns: every Space with its sealed root
repositories; published Spaces are named spaces/{id}

item.returns: one Space as an OCI artifact

verify.expected_from: the catalog, the tree listing or the manifest -- never the source that served the bytes
verify.root: every file is named in holospace.lock.json with its sha256, and `root` is the sha256 over that map; one changed byte changes the root
